heading: **21 January 2026**
body:
*PE PCR plate preparation*

For HT-SELEX:

6 uL Mastermix \+ 1.5 uL PE\_F \+ 1.5 uL PE3\_R (X2)

NOTE: While adding the master-mix to the plates there is a small chance that some of the barcodes from the different wells may have been mixed.

*Hia5 buffer preparation*

Based on recent HT-SELEX \+ FIBER-Seq (HTFS) testing, 0.02 uL of the original Hia5 should be sufficient per well → This works out to be \~8 uL of the total enzyme diluted across \~400 wells.

Amount of Hia5 buffer to be used \= 520 uL 

Amount of SAM \= 200 uL

5 mL

| 1 M Tris pH 8 | 75 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EDTA (0.5 M) | 10 uL |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 5 uL |
| NaCl (100 mM) | 750 uL |
| KCl (100 mM) | 3000 uL |
| Spermidine (100X) | (1X) 50 uL |

 

Basically, I reconsitute 20ul nucleosome with 4ug DNA ligand, then I add 20x molar ratio of ELF2 to the nucleosome (not the whole 20ul, just the amount needed from EcoRV digestion, the rest I keep at 4deg for up to a month), incubate at 25deg fro 15min, then add cutsmart buffer & EcoRV & incubate at 37deg fro 15min. Then I add a mixture of SDS+proteinase K to stop the digestion (detail see the attached file), and incubate at 55deg for 10min. Before running the gel, I purify the DNA with the qiagen PCR purification kit (so the gel looks nicer) and load 100-200ng DNA onto a 3% agarose gel and run on ice (I found out that the gel turns out quite ugly if I load more than 200ng DNA).

- Prepare this mix and aliquot 7.5 uL per well  
- Add PE\_R primer with barcodes (1.5 uL)  
- Add 9 uL of cyc3 DNA

For both ligands the PCR will be 25 cycles in total.

*ELF ligand recon \+ EcoRV assay*

Prepare 10 tubes of dried 4 M KCl with a volume of 10 uL → to allow for resuspension in 20 uL of DNA ligand → to achieve final salt concentration of 2 M at the beginning of reconstitution

Low salt RB (2 L)

37.28 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

Resuspend 1.54 g of DTT in 10 mL of water to prepare a 1 M stock if needed.

High salt RB (2 L)

298.2 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

*HTFS*

- Perform protein-DNA incubation in 384-well PCR plates (30 mins, RT)  
- Add 2 uL of Hia5 master mix per well → Incubate at 37 degrees for 75 mins  
- Collect all DNA and pool into 96-well plates → Column purify  
- PNK treatment \+ heat inactivation   
- Overnight ligation \+ QC of long-read DNA

*Hia5 master-mix distribution*

Take 17.6 uL Hia5 \+ 158.4 uL Hia5 buffer (dHia5)

1144 uL Buffer \+ 440 uL SAM \+ 176 dHia5 \= 1760 uL

18.3 uL per well of a quadrant of 384-well PCR plate
